Have you already challenged SABINE,
the LEADER of PIRIN ARENA?\pHer grandfather was famous.
He was one of the FOUR TRIALS in the\lILUM TEMPLE at one point.\pI wouldn't be surprised if SABINE
became a great TRAINER in her\lown right.$
INYUSU TOR\n“A farming town in the ashfall.”$
MOVE TUTOR'S HOUSE\n“New moves taught to COMPANIONS.”$
See!\nMy COMPANION won all these RIBBONS!\pHave yours earned any RIBBONS?\nYou can check them on your COMLINK.$

You know how BATTLE TENTS offer
different events in different towns?\pMy favorite is definitely the BATTLE
TENT in INYUSU TOR.\pI think it's fantastic how TRAINERS
try to win with all their faith in\ltheir COMPANIONS.$
DR. TIEN: Oh…\nI never should have let myself be\lconned into telling the EMPIRE where\lyou can find METEORITES…\pThat METEORITE from STARFALL CAVERN…\nIt's never going to be mine now…$

Oh!
Hah?\pThat item…\pCould it be?\pIs it the METEORITE that the EMPIRE
took from STARFALL CAVERN?\pPlease, may I have it?\pI'm not asking for it for free.
How about in exchange for this TM?$
DR. TIEN went off to STARFALL CAVERN\non ROUTE 114 with some people from\lthe EMPIRE.$

I'm the MOVE TUTOR.\pI know all the moves that COMPANIONS
learn--every one of them--and I can\lteach COMPANIONS those moves.\pI can teach a move to a COMPANION
of yours if you'd like.\pI'll do it for a HEART SCALE.
I'm collecting those now.$

Oh, hello.
You are?\pOkay, your name's {PLAYER}{KUN}.
I can see that you're a TRAINER.\pSo that means you use the COMPANION
Storage System I developed.\pHow I arrived at that conclusion is
a simple deductive process.\pYou spoke to me because you wanted
to access something on this terminal.\pOh, I'm sorry. I'm TESS.\pHonestly, I'm glad to meet you--it's
great you're using the Storage System.\pIf you could, please visit me at home.
My house is on ROUTE 114.$
I wonder what COMPANIONS looked like\nlong, long ago?\pMaybe the FOSSIL MANIAC at the edge\nof town will know.$
This region's been known for meteors\nsince the olden days.\pThey say STARFALL CAVERN was carved\nout by a falling meteorite long ago.$

With a MAGMA SHARD, all COMPANIONS
up to Level 50, even those you get in\ltrades from other people, will obey\lyou completely.\pAnd, it lets COMPANIONS use the HM move
STRENGTH outside of battle.\pThis is a token of my appreciation.
Don't be shy about taking it!$
My wife's warming an EGG in the hot\nsprings. This is what she told me.\pShe left two COMPANIONS at the\nNURSERY. And they found that EGG!$
Heh?\pI don't know who you are, but if you get\nin the way of the EMPIRE, don't\lexpect any mercy!$
Hold it right there, EMPIRE scum!\pYou're badly mistaken if you think you\ncan have your way with the galaxy!$

Hehehe!
Even the CARTEL shows up!\pBut it's too much trouble to deal with
you all…\pHeh, it doesn't matter!\pWe've got the METEORITE, so off to
MUSTAFAR PEAK we go!\pHehehe! Be seeing you, you CARTEL
slimeballs!$

JABBA: Didn't I see you before?
At MOS EISLEY's MUSEUM?\pAh, so your name is {PLAYER}.\pAt the time, I thought you were one
of the EMPIRE's goons.\pHo ho ho…
You're one odd kid.\pThe EMPIRE is a dangerous group of
total fanatics.\pThey scorch and pave whole worlds,
claiming to bring order.\pThey are the rivals to us,
the swamp-loving CARTEL!$
Mighty JABBA, we should give chase\nto the EMPIRE…$
JABBA: Yes, yes, we must!\nWe've got to hurry.\pThere's no telling what the EMPIRE\nwill do at MUSTAFAR PEAK!$
JABBA: {PLAYER}, you should keep\nan eye out for the EMPIRE, too.\pFarewell!$

I… I'm TIEN…
I'm a PROFESSOR…\pThe EMPIRE asked me to guide them
to STARFALL CAVERN…\pBut they tricked me.
They even took my METEORITE away…\pAnd then another bunch,
the CARTEL, showed up.\pAfter that…
I don't understand any of it.\pBut the EMPIRE…\pWhat are they going to do with that
METEORITE at MUSTAFAR PEAK?$
DR. TIEN: But the EMPIRE…\pWhat are they going to do with that\nMETEORITE at MUSTAFAR PEAK?$
This is where we NIGHTBROTHERS train\nour great beasts.\pThey say a JEDI once trained here.\nNow do you see how special it is here?$
The road ahead remains long and harsh.\pWhen will my COMPANIONS and I become\nthe best?$
JARO: We've always battled COMPANIONS\ntogether as a twosome.\lWe've confidence in ourselves.$
JARO: We've always battled COMPANIONS\ntogether as a twosome.\lWe've confidence in ourselves.$

LEIA: Oh, wow, {PLAYER}{KUN}.
I'm amazed you knew where to find me.\pDo you, uh…maybe think of me as
just a crystal maniac?\pNo, that can't be right.\pWe battled alongside each other at
the YAVIN 4 LAUNCH TOWER.\pYou should have a very good idea
about how good I am.\pOkay, {PLAYER}{KUN}, if you're going to mount
a serious challenge, expect the worst!$
notes: Emerald text says SOOTOPOLIS SPACE CENTER (source typo); the space center is on MOSSDEEP = YAVIN 4

sw_text_raw:
LEIA: Come to think of it, ever since
our paths first crossed in the\lSHADOWLANDS of KASHYYYK, I felt it.\pI thought that you would eventually
pass the TRIALS OF ILUM.\pMy predictions usually come true.\pAnd where will you go from here?\p… … … … … …
… … … … … …\pFufufu, even I couldn't tell you that.$

VADER: Hm?
Who are you?\p… … … … … …
… … … … … …\pJABBA has been complaining about a
child meddling in the CARTEL's\laffairs.\pIt must be you he meant.\pSo you think you can interfere
with the EMPIRE?\pNow you listen.
Water breeds swamps, and swamps\lbreed disorder.\pSolid land can be ordered.
It can be built on and controlled.\pThe EMPIRE will expand the land of
every world in the galaxy.\pAnd for that, we need the power of
what sleeps within this mountain…\pI have said too much.\pBut, no matter!
I will show you the power of\lthe dark side!$
notes: Vader's motive mirrors Jabba's: land and order vs swamps (bible/STORY.md)

sw_text_raw: Impressive…\nMost impressive.$

VADER: Enough.
I will withdraw, for now.\pThe Force is strong with you…
But this is not the last you will\lsee of the EMPIRE.\pEven without the METEORITE, once
I possess the BLUE KYBER…$
Hehehe!\pSo you've come all the way here!\pBut you're too late!\nI've already delivered the METEORITE\lfrom STARFALL CAVERN to LORD VADER!$
Hehehe…\pEven though I've lost, if LORD VADER\nawakens that thing…$
LORD VADER, hurry!\nGive it the METEORITE's energy!\pHehehe…$
We of the EMPIRE are working hard for\neveryone's sake.\pLike, if that thing's power made more\nland, there'd be more places to live.\pEveryone'd be happy!$
LORD VADER says, “It will bring order\nto everyone.”\pBut why does everyone keep getting\nin our way?$
A kid like you, you ought to be\nplaying in the sand!$
That annoying CARTEL…\nThey always mess with our plans!$
We're the EMPIRE!\pThey're the CARTEL!\pThey're nothing but smugglers\nin fancy robes!$

JABBA: Grr, {PLAYER}!
I should've guessed you'd show up!\pSee for yourself what the fanatics
of the EMPIRE are up to!\pThey're trying to inject the stolen
METEORITE's power into the volcano!\pDoing something like that will cause
the volcano's eruption!$

JABBA: {PLAYER}!
Thank you!\pWith your help, we thwarted the
EMPIRE's destructive plan!\pBut… You…
Whose side are you on?\pHo ho ho, it doesn't matter.\pWe will remain vigilant and keep up
our pursuit of the EMPIRE.\p{PLAYER}, we shall meet again!$
Darn… The EMPIRE outnumbers us!\nWe can't keep up with them!$
If they expand the land, there'll be\nfewer swamps for HUTTS!$
We're the CARTEL!\pThey're the EMPIRE!\pThey're nothing but bullies in\nshiny armor!$
ASH CAKES are MUSTAFAR PEAK's local\nspecialty.\pTry one. It's just 200 credits.$
{DOWN_ARROW} ASHEN PASS\nPIRIN AHEAD$
If you can mesh your heart with those\nof your COMPANIONS, why, you should be\lable to achieve great things.$
Perhaps your heart has become one\nwith the hearts of your COMPANIONS.$
I've finally made it to MUSTAFAR PEAK.\nI want to make my COMPANIONS battle!$
Like I said, I've finally made it to\nMUSTAFAR PEAK. It would be a shame if\lI only do a little sightseeing…\pI want to get in some battles and buy\nASH CAKES as souvenirs.$
I've been to the lava springs and\nrefreshed my tired bones.\lRight now I'm feeling strong!$
Since I bathed in the lava springs,\nI've been feeling great!\lI'm sure I'm going to win!$
Yowch!\nI'm getting a chill out of the springs.$
I'll have to take another dip in the\nlava springs. Want to join me?\pJust joking!$
The SHUTTLE is ready to go down.\nWould you like to be on it?$
Did you know?\pSome people cleverly ride their\nbikes up this horribly bumpy pass.$
My bike bounced around so much,\nmy rear end's sore…$
Picnics are fun wherever you go.\nJust like COMPANIONS!$

MIRA: {PLAYER}{KUN}! Long time no see!\pOh? While I visited the hot springs,
you got the PIRIN ARENA SHARD.\pYou must have collected
good COMPANIONS…\lNo, I believe you raised some.\pI guess it would be okay for you to
have this.$

I have here an EGG.\pI'd hoped to hatch it by covering it in
hot sand by the hot springs.\lBut that doesn't seem to be enough…\pI've heard it would be best if it were
kept together with COMPANIONS and\lcarried about.\pYou are a TRAINER, yes?
And your COMPANIONS radiate vitality.\pSo, what say you?
Will you take this EGG to hatch?$
I bathe in the hot springs every day.\pI want to become a wise and strong\nARENA LEADER like SABINE.$
If people put COMPANIONS in hot\nsprings, it might be seriously strange.\pWhy, it might be an electric bath, or\na bubble bath, or even a lava bath…$
PIRIN\p“HOT SPRINGS OF SULLUST\nAn excellent place for relaxing!”$
PIRIN HERB SHOP\n“Bitter taste--better cure!”$

Hey, how's it going, ILUM-bound
{PLAYER}?\pPIRIN's ARENA LEADER SABINE
uses FIRE-type COMPANIONS.\pHer passion for COMPANIONS burns
hotter than a volcano.\pDon't get too close to her--you'll burn!
Hose her down with water and then\lgo for it!$
Can your COMPANIONS withstand\n392-degree heat?$
I'm going to be a quick and strong\nTRAINER just like SABINE.$

Welcome… No, wait.\pPuny TRAINER, how good to see you've
made it here!\pI have been entrusted with the…
No, wait.\pI am SABINE, and I'm the ARENA
LEADER here!\pUh…
Dare not underestimate me, though\lI have been LEADER only a short time!\pWith skills inherited from my
grandfather, I shall, uh…demonstrate\lthe hot moves we have honed on\lSULLUST!$

Oh…
I guess I was trying too hard…\pI… I've only recently become
an ARENA LEADER.\pI tried too hard to be someone
I'm not.\pI have to do things my natural way. If
I don't, my COMPANIONS will be confused.\pThanks for teaching me that.
For that, you deserve this.$
That TM50 contains OVERHEAT.\pThat move inflicts serious damage on\nthe opponent.\pBut it also sharply cuts the SP. ATK\nof the COMPANION using it. It might not\lbe suitable for longer battles.$

SABINE: Losing a battle isn't going
to deflate me.\pI love COMPANIONS.
I love to battle.\lAnd… I love this ARENA!\pLet's exchange superhot moves
in another battle!$

SABINE: Losing a battle isn't going
to deflate me.\pI love COMPANIONS.
I love to battle.\lAnd… I love this ARENA!\pLet's exchange superhot moves
in another battle!\pOh, wait. Do you only have one
COMPANION that can battle?\pI hate to say this, but when you come
see me, bring at least two COMPANIONS.$
Herbal medicine works impressively well.\nBut your COMPANIONS will dislike you.\lIt must be horribly bitter!$
It's sort of magical how just sitting\nin a hot-spring pool can invigorate.\pI wish I could let my COMPANIONS\nsoak, too.$
Something's happening,\nand I don't like it!\pI've seen shady characters wandering\nin and out of DR. TIEN's home…$
See! Take a look!\nThis is my precious BLOOPKIT!\pIt's slick and smooth and plushy, too!$
BLOOPKIT: Rooreelooo.$
BATTLE TENT INYUSU TOR SITE\n“May the Greatest Teams Gather!”$
We do all right in the preliminary round,\nbut we can never win the appeals…\pMaybe it means I have to watch what\nother contestants are doing…$
I can't beat ARENA LEADERS…\pI can't win any SHOWCASES…\pI've been here, there, and everywhere,\nand it's all for naught…$
SHOWCASES\nSUPER RANK STAGE!$
Fufufufufu.\pI'm going to make everyone think\nI'm just a kid and let them play down.\pThen, I'll shock them and grab\nthe title!$

I heard something about some tent,
so I came to camp out.\pI didn't know that tents these days
are so luxurious!\pSince I'm here, I may as well try
my hand at battling!$

LANDO: Hi, {PLAYER}{KUN}!
So you came out to this BATTLE TENT!\pThe people in these parts tend to be
easygoing and laid-back.\pBut, you see, what I'm looking for are
people with…\pHow should I say this?\pSomeone bursting with the desire
and the drive to win.\pIf there were a TRAINER like that,
I'd immediately…\pWhoops! Never mind!
Keep working at it!$
LANDO: Instead of wasting your\ntime with the likes of me, why not\lmake a challenge?$
DR. TIEN: This TM, it represents\nmy feeling of gratitude.\lPlease use it!$
DR. TIEN: Oh, I can't believe it.\nThis is really, really great!\pThis is really going to help my research!$
DR. TIEN: Oh, but…\nI'm crushed with disappointment…$
DR. TIEN: Please, may I have that\nMETEORITE?\pI'm not asking for it for free.\nHow about in exchange for this TM?$
Poor DR. TIEN…\nHe's so depressed… I feel sorry for him.$
Look at DR. TIEN…\nHe's so happy! I think it's cute.$

I'm having a hard time deciding if I
should make my LOTHKIT evolve or not.\pI only have to use this MOON STONE,
but it's so hard to decide…\pIf I make it evolve, it will become
much stronger.\pBut it will look so different, too.$
LOTHKIT: Miyao?$
This NUGGET I found here…\nI suppose I'll have to sell it, seeing\las how it has no other use.$
Oh! That's it! That's an honest to\ngoodness HEART SCALE!\pLet me guess, you want me to teach\na move?$
Which COMPANION needs tutoring?$
Which move should I teach?$
Sorry…\pIt doesn't appear as if I have any move\nI can teach that COMPANION.$
{PLAYER} handed over one HEART SCALE\nin exchange.$
If your COMPANIONS need to learn a\nmove, come back with a HEART SCALE.$
Hunh? There isn't a single move that\nI can teach an EGG.$
In the fields of INYUSU TOR, we plant\nseedlings of hardy trees that thrive\leven in volcanic ash.$
MUSTAFAR PEAK's ASHEN PASS…\pNow this is what I've always wanted\nin a dig site.\pThis jagged, ore-rich rock…\nIt rocks my soul!$
Losing left me bitter!$
Yes, I did lose at COMPANION…\pBut, when it comes to the love of\nthe mountains, I have you beat!$
This place isn't your casual hike.\nIt's not suited for a picnic.$
Ohhh, no!\nThe ground is too bumpy…$
Will you ever be back in this area?\nIf you do return, I'd like a rematch.$
I only lost because the ground is\ntoo bumpy!$
I'll forget about losing and just\nenjoy this bumpy hike.$
ASHEN PASS is hard to walk on.\nIt's a good place for training.$
It was all over while we were still\ntrying to find a good footing…$
If I had a SPEEDER BIKE, I'd be able to\njump ledges.$
When I get more used to this bumpiness,\nI'll be sure to win!\pCan you register me in your COMLINK?$
I got used to this bumpiness.\nI sing while I climb now.$
It's still not easy to battle on this\nbumpy ground…$
I should get a SPEEDER BIKE from WALD\nin MOS ESPA…$
Wah!\nWhat are you doing here?\pWhat am I doing in a place like this?\pWhat business is it of yours?$
Urrrgh…\pI should've ducked into our HIDEOUT\nright away…$
Okay, oh-kay!\nI admit it--you're strong!\pDon't worry about me.\nGo wherever you want!$
Oh! This boulder is shaking in response\nto the CODE CYLINDER!$
Aiyeeh! It's awfully scary to shoot\ndown the mountain on a swoop!$
I feel like I'm falling apart…$
I climb this hill every day.\nI have confidence in my strength!$
Hmm…\nWhat went wrong?$
What is that odd rock protrusion\na little up the hill from here?$

MIRA: With those SAND GOGGLES, you'll
have no trouble getting through the\ldesert near ROUTE 111.\pBut, wow, {PLAYER}{KUN}…
Challenging ARENAS…\pYou're trying hard because you don't
want to lose to me, I bet!\p{PLAYER}{KUN}, I think I should challenge
your dad in MOS ENTHA ARENA.\pSee you again!$

KAEL: {PLAYER}, hey, it's been a while.
How's it going?\pHmm…
That's a decent collection of SHARDS.\pAll right, then.
You may as well have this.$

KAEL: Keep those with you if you're
planning on going into that desert near\lROUTE 111.\pThere should be some COMPANIONS that
are exclusively desert-dwellers.\lYou might look around for those.\pAs for me…
I'm considering challenging DORAN,\lthe ARENA LEADER of MOS ENTHA.\pUnlike you, {PLAYER}, your dad looks like
he really is tough.\pSee you around!$
Good! I hope you'll walk plenty with\nthis here EGG!$
{PLAYER} received the EGG.$
Oh? You've too many COMPANIONS.\nThere's no room for this EGG…$
As you wish, then…\pIf you have a change of heart about\nhatching this EGG, I will be here.$
Every so often, an EGG will be found at\nthe COMPANION NURSERY.\pOr at least that's how the rumor goes.$

We draw as much hot water as we need,\nand yet the hot springs never run dry.\pIsn't it magical?\pThese hot springs appear near active\nvolcanoes. Veins of water under the\lground are heated by magma to well up\las hot springs.$
Being buried in this hot sand is…\nSigh…\pSo warm and heavenly…\pEh? Gyaah! Ouch!\pA COMPANION nipped my backside!$
Oh, you like hot springs, do you?\pThat's surprising for one as young\nas you.$
They're claiming that these hot springs\nare good for calming nervous tension,\lrelieving aching muscles, solving\lromantic problems, and attracting\lmoney…$
PIRIN ARENA\nLEADER: SABINE\l“One with a fiery passion that burns!”$
Yow! That was a scorching-hot battle!$
Owowowowow!\nYikes, it's hot!$
I'm blinded by sweat in my eyes…$
Being buried in hot sand promotes\ncirculation.\pIt's effective for healing pain in\nyour joints.$
I'm trying to relieve my stress.\nDon't come along and stress me out!$
I hope SABINE flames you good!$
Haaah… Whew…\pIf you spend too much time buried in\nhot sand, it tuckers you out…$
You must be getting tired by now.\nYou'd like to rest in the hot sand,\lwouldn't you?\pBut you should know that maintaining\nyour willpower is an important ability\lfor all TRAINERS.$
Play with fire, and be burned…$
Your skill is real…\nBut our LEADER SABINE is strong.\pIf you don't watch yourself, you'll be\nburned seriously.$
It didn't burn hotly enough…$
The temperature of magma is\n392 degrees.\pYour COMPANION beat me, so they should\neasily survive in magma.$
Um…\nOkay, I'll battle with you.$
Oh, but you're too strong.$
Come on, get with it!\nLet's go before my feelings cool!$
It's so hot, and yet my heart is\nclutched by ice…$
The way the battling spirit burns\nwithin you, you may stand a chance\lagainst our LEADER.$
See how the flames blaze wildly?\nThey flare in anticipation of my win!$
Something didn't go right.$
Well, so what? I say so what?\nI can walk on hot coals barefoot!\p…Don't even think about trying it!$
As much as I love digging,\nI especially love lava mines.$
Well, it seems to me I lost without\never being in control.$
I stay here because I became a fan\nof SABINE's power.\pHehehehe.$
{PLAYER} received the MAGMA SHARD\nfrom SABINE.$
Registered ARENA LEADER SABINE\nin the COMLINK.$
Your power reminds me of someone…\pOh! I know! You battle like DORAN,\nthe ARENA LEADER of MOS ENTHA.$
PIRIN ARENA$
PIRIN ARENA\pSABINE'S CERTIFIED TRAINERS:\n{PLAYER}$
Whew!\nOn the verge of eruption!$

SABINE: I lost the match,
but I'm completely satisfied.\pIt's not often I get to enjoy a battle
this heated.\pLet's have another one like this
again sometime!$
Welcome to the HERB SHOP, home of\neffective and inexpensive medicine!$
You've come to look at herbal medicine\nin PIRIN?\pThat's rather commendable.\pI like you! Take this!$

That CHARCOAL I gave you, it's used
for making herbal medicine.\pIt also does wonders when held by
a COMPANION.\pIt intensifies the power of FIRE-type
moves.$
SCURRIER: Pshoo!$
Use X SPEED to add to a COMPANION's\nSPEED in battle.\pThat will help it get in the first\nstrike--a decided advantage!$
On MUSTAFAR PEAK's peak, there's a local\nspecialty that you can buy only there.\pGive it to a COMPANION--it will be\nelated.$
I think COMPANIONS get closer to their\nTRAINERS if they spend time together.\pThe longer the better.\nThat's what I think.$
Hohoho! Hey, kid, you can reach\nthe hot springs from here.\pIf COMPANIONS are getting rest, so too\nshould their TRAINERS.$
Hehehe!\pWith this METEORITE, that thing in\nMUSTAFAR PEAK will…$
Urgh!\nI didn't expect you to be so strong!$
I want to know more about your power.\nLet me register you in my COMLINK.$
Since we met, we have trained hard\nwith our sights on number one.\pHelp us see how much stronger we've\nbecome!$
Urgh!\nI didn't expect you to be so strong!$
You've obviously kept up your\nCOMPANION training.\pSo long as you remain strong, I, too,\ncan become stronger!$
JARO: Oh, my.\nWe've lost, dear wife.$
JARO: We've been married for\nfifty years.\pCome to think of it, I've yet to beat\nmy dear wife in a battle.$
JARO: Well, well, what a young TRAINER!\pWill you battle with us? If so, you'll\nhave to return with more COMPANIONS.$
JARO: Young TRAINER, if the chance\narises, will you battle with us again?$
JIA: We've been married for\nfifty years.\pThe bond we share as a couple could\nnever be broken.$
JIA: Oh, dear.\nWe've lost, my dear husband.$
JIA: Fifty years of marriage…\pIf we ever argued, we always settled\nit with a COMPANION battle…$
JIA: Well, well, aren't you a young\nTRAINER?\pIf you'd care to battle with us, you'll\nhave to come back with more\lCOMPANIONS.$
JARO: Oh, my.\nWe've lost, dear wife.$
JARO: Married for fifty years…\pOn reflection, the dear wife and I,\nwe battled day in and day out…$
JARO: Well, well, what a young TRAINER!\pWill you battle with us? If so, you'll\nhave to return with more COMPANIONS.$
JIA: We've been married for\nfifty years.\pWe've supported each other all that\ntime. We've made ourselves strong.$
JIA: Oh, dear.\nWe've lost, my dear husband.$

JIA: Well, well, aren't you a young\nTRAINER?\pIf you'd care to battle with us, you'll\nhave to come back with more\lCOMPANIONS.$
You…\nI had no idea you'd become so strong…$

The power contained in the METEORITE…\pBy amplifying its power with this\nmachine, MUSTAFAR PEAK's volcanic\lactivity will instantly intensify…\pIts energy will grow deep inside\nthe crater and…\lFufufu…$
Hunh?\nWhat do you mean I lost?$
If there were more land, I'd be able\nto get a big house of my own!\pI'm going to build it on hardened lava!$
My dream of a big house…$
METEORITES pack amazing power!$
You'd better not mess with us!\pWe're trying to awaken that thing\nfor the benefit of everyone!$
Yeah!\nDouse them in fire!$
We're going to keep making more land!$
Bufoh!$
JABBA: Grrr…\pI want to stop that VADER,\nbut I can't!\pNot when I have my hands full battling\nthree opponents at once!$
Bushaa!$
Thank you, dear!$
Oh, dear. You can't buy a thing if\nyou've not got the money.$
Oh, fine then.$
A METEORITE is fitted on a mysterious\nmachine…\pThe machine seems to be storing\nenergy in the METEORITE.$
A METEORITE is fitted on a mysterious\nmachine…\pDo you want to remove the METEORITE?$
{PLAYER} removed the METEORITE from\nthe mysterious machine.$
{PLAYER} left the METEORITE where\nit was.$
This mysterious machine…\nIt makes no response whatsoever.$
Oh, my goodness.\nNow, aren't you something!$
Well, well, I've lost. I can't call\nmyself an EXPERT now, can I?$
Thank you, child. It was fun, as if\nI were battling my own grandchild.\pPlease, come see me again for\na rematch.$
Oh, my goodness.\nNow, aren't you something!$
I've got the fire in me, baby.\nI can't stand it! I have to battle!$
Ooh, that was a scorching-hot match!$
The heat of MUSTAFAR PEAK warms\nme up, baby!$
The way you battle…\nIt's like a MUSTAFAR PEAK eruption!$
Fine work camp, this! Plenty of\nhot folks around for company!$
Oh, you're a real firebrand, too!$
I think I need a dip in PIRIN\nHOT SPRING with the locals!$
I like little fireballs like you.\nLet me register you in my COMLINK.$
